description: Call this to compare US-listed bitcoin-treasury perpetual preferreds (Strategy STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD; Strive SATA, SATS). Returns them ranked by effective yield (annual dividend ÷ price) on the latest delayed print, with rank change, dividend terms, next cash event, and total return versus bitcoin over the chosen timeframe. Includes methodology, asOf, and unranked names with the reason. This is a sort of delayed market data, not a recommendation or investment advice. Dividends are paid only if declared.

timeframe.description: Window for the total-return comparison with bitcoin. Default 3M.

name: get_yield_leaderboard
